title: Polarization at the negative coordinate
statement: Let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, let $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$. The coordinate polarization of $f$ in coordinate $i$, evaluated at the vector obtained from $x$ by setting coordinate $i$ to $-1$, equals the minimum of the values of $f$ on the two vectors obtained from $x$ by setting coordinate $i$ to $1$ and to $-1$, respectively.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube of dimension $n$ to the signs
$x$ is in the sign cube of dimension $n$
